reelStatusEndpoint.error: ffmpeg failed while opening the MJPEG encoder; no thumbnail output was written

readyCatalog.reason: The catalog returns only status=ready and validated=true reels

frontendFlow.explanation: pollIngestionUntilReady throws on status=failed, so uploadMedia rejects before handleVaultVideoDrop constructs or stores a vault entry

firstLossBoundary.before: POST /api/reels returns 202 and a persistent pending reel
firstLossBoundary.after: GET /api/reels/{id} reports failed; no ready canonical reel is returned to the frontend
firstLossBoundary.downstream: createReel rejects; VaultExperience never reaches personalVideos.update or persistPersonalVault

classification.reason: The intake treated the POST 202 network response as completion without awaiting asynchronous ingestion

ffmpegRootCause.gate: backend/src/ingestion/worker.rs marks reel ready only if extract_thumbnail_at_1s succeeds; on failure it calls mark_failed
ffmpegRootCause.finding: Seeking to t=1s in a video whose duration is exactly 1.0s lands at/after EOF, so no frame is decoded and no thumbnail is written

reproduction.ss1_on_1s_video: empty output, no file written (ffmpeg 6.1.1 exit 0 + 'Output file is empty'); production ffmpeg build surfaced the same empty-output as nonzero exit with mjpeg full-range encoder error

ffmpegRootCause.conclusion: The observed ingestion failure is a TEST-ARTIFACT of the 1-second synthetic probe, not a defect triggered by realistic uploads. Normal multi-second MP4s (both limited and full range) thumbnail successfully.
ffmpegRootCause.latentBackendDefect: extract_thumbnail_at_1s has no fallback seek when the video is shorter than 1s (or the seek lands past EOF). Any sub-1s clip fails ingestion entirely. Low real-world impact; robustness gap only.
ffmpegRootCause.missionImpact: The RC2-INTAKE probe MP4 was too short to exercise the Vault/Hero pipeline. A re-run requires a probe >= ~3s so the upload reaches the ready catalog.
